subject: general
question: 1000 identical small spheres are cast from a sphere of radius 10 cm, with the total volume of the small spheres being equal to the volume of the larger sphere. The diameter (in cm) of each of the small spheres is:
solution:
Given:

Radius of bigger sphere is 10 cm.

Formula Used:

Radius = Diameter/2

Volume of sphere = 4/3 π.r³

Number of spheres can be made,

Volume of bigger sphere/Volume of smaller sphere

Calculation:

Radius of bigger sphere,

⇒ 10 cm

Volume of 1000 small spheres

⇒ 4/3 πr³

Volume of a bigger sphere,

⇒ 4/3 πR³

⇒ 4/3 π(10)³

⇒ (4/3) π(10)(10)(10) 

According to question,

Volume of bigger sphere = volume of 1000 smaller spheres

⇒ (4/3)π(1000) = 1000(4/3)πr³

⇒ r³ = 1

⇒r = 1 cm

So, Diameter = 2 cm

∴ The Diameter of the bigger sphere is 2 cm.
